name: Dominik Mysterio
profileSummary: Dominik Óscar Gutiérrez, better known by the ring name Dominik Mysterio, is an American professional wrestler. He is signed to WWE, where he performs on the Raw brand and is a member of The Judgment Day stable. He also appears in WWE's sister promotion Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide (AAA), where he is a member of the El Ojo stable and the current AAA Mega Champion in his first reign. Mysterio is also a former two-time WWE Intercontinental Champion.
